limitations.note: The rewrite kept the faulty two-input cadence instead of making count 2 reachable and aligning the second data write with it, so it omitted the output due on every third accepted byte.
The test exercised the third accepted byte but explicitly expected no output, so it validated the rewrite's assumption rather than checking for the required valid output of 12'hC2E.
